programmes.programName: Management Science and Operations PhD programme
programmes.evidence: The official Management Science and Operations area explicitly offers this PhD programme with open applications. Doctoral research studies operations and decision-making in supply chains, platforms and healthcare systems. The school-wide subject inventory requires original independent research, thesis and defence for the PhD degree.
limitations: One subject-area doctoral programme, not separate degrees for each application domain. Original historical founding and uninterrupted intake dates are not established.

branches.conclusion: Complete current inventory of seven school PhD subjects read; Management Science and Operations is the explicit qualifying route.

The complete school doctoral inventory contains seven business-related subject areas and no separate engineering branch or engineering doctorate. This conclusion is bounded to the documented London Business School inventory.

sources.note: Current Management Science and Operations PhD programme has open applications and explicitly studies processes and decisions in digital platforms, supply chains, healthcare and nonprofits through quantitative research.

Complete seven-subject PhD inventory: Accounting, Economics, Finance, Management Science and Operations, Marketing, Organisational Behaviour, Strategy and Entrepreneurship. Shared structure requires independent research, thesis and thesis defence leading to the PhD award.
Current PhD overview uses LBS and London Business School interchangeably; research training, supervisor support and current 2026/2027 funding stated.

limitations: School inventory checked as of 22 October 2026; no census of historical provision claimed. Aliases share the same canonical doctoral programme and current unit identity.
